# Object Studio assets

Source: https://jasonsperske.github.io/object_studio/agent/
Source repository: https://github.com/jasonsperske/object_studio
Retrieved 2026-09-19.

The shelf-unit and ggie-radio generators are Object Studio's CC0-1.0 work,
as declared by its public agent/index.json catalog. The GGIE radio is a
photo-based interpretation, not a measured replica. The runtime includes
Three.js (MIT); its license notices are retained in studio-runtime.js.

Models run locally and require no connection to Object Studio at runtime.
